info.title: Bytewise.Mcp
info.description: The Bytewise Solutions operator MCP server — a local stdio Model Context Protocol server exposing read-only project monitoring (crashes, feedback, dashboards, revenue, alerts) to AI tools over a machine-local paired McpAgent credential.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
bytewise-mcp — local stdio MCP server exposing read-only Bytewise Solutions operator monitoring (crashes, feedback, dashboards, revenue, alerts) to AI tools.

Credential: 'bytewise-mcp pair' mints a machine-local, READ-ONLY McpAgent token via a web pairing code (BYTEWISE_MCP_TOKEN overrides it, bound to $BYTEWISE_API_ORIGIN).
Environment: BYTEWISE_API_ORIGIN, BYTEWISE_MCP_TOKEN, BYTEWISE_DEFAULT_PROJECT, BYTEWISE_MCP_CREDENTIAL_STORE.
Running with no command serves MCP over stdio (what an MCP host should launch).

options.name: --origin
options.description: API origin URL (default: $BYTEWISE_API_ORIGIN, then the paired origin in the config file). HTTPS required; plain HTTP only for loopback development.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the stdio MCP server (the default when no command is given).

options.name: --project
options.description: Default project slug for tools called without a 'project' argument (default: $BYTEWISE_DEFAULT_PROJECT, then the config file).

commands.name: pair
commands.description: Pair this machine: create an MCP (McpAgent, read-only) pairing code on the web Security page bound to the printed challenge, paste it here, and the code is exchanged for a stored token. The code is read from stdin, never a command argument; the token is stored, never printed.

commands.name: unpair
commands.description: Revoke this machine's credential server-side and delete it locally.
